label: AI Insight UI — Data Products
info:
Data Products subflow per FAP §10. Exposes the data-product catalogue over UIBUILDER for future consumers. The restored Vue views currently derive products from simulation feeds (meters, PV, streetlights, traffic zones) directly via simGet helpers — this subflow provides a parallel FAP-aligned API for migrations.

Actions:
  data-products.list             — full catalogue
  data-products.detail (id)      — single product manifest
  data-products.energy.list      — energy domain only
  data-products.city.list        — city domain only

Products are synthesised from globally known feed presence. When the gold-layer
`data_products` table is available in Trino, replace the synthesizer below with
a Trino query.

name: data-products.* router
